newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end lower across the board.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end lower across the board.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures closed lower on Wednesday as technical selling from local investors emerged early in the afternoon, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.6 to 2.0 yen per kg lower, with the benchmark November 1997 ending 1.5 yen down at 136.8 yen.
"Some investors tried to take profits today after prices rose," a brokerage house trader said.
On Tuesday, Tokyo rubber futures rose, as bullish sentiment carried over from Monday when the stronger expiry of spot May lifted prices.
